data.long_meaning: Derived from the Scottish name Iain Mhòir (John the Great), which was a nickname for a large or important John. In turn, John is derived from the Hebrew name Yehohanan, which means 'God is gracious'. Therefore, Jamieson can be interpreted as 'Son of the God Who is Gracious'.
